title: National Electric Power Regulatory Authority Licensing Procedure For Filing Appeals Regulations 2012

sections.shortTitle: National Electric Power Regulatory Authority Licensing Procedure For Filing Appeals Regulations 2012
sections.section: RULES - National Electric Power Regulatory Authority Licensing (Procedure For Filing Appeals) Regulations 2012
sections.description:
NATIONAL ELECTRIC POWER REGULATORY
NATIONAL ELECTRIC POWER REGULATORY
AUTHORITY LICENSING (PROCEDURE FOR FILING
APPEALS) REGULATIONS, 2012
(Amendments)
[Gazette of Pakistan, Extraordinary Part II,
10th June, 2013]
S.R.O.
562(I)/2013, dated 28-5-2013.---In exercise of power conferred by Section 47 of
the Regulation of Generation, Transmission and Distribution of Electric Power
Act (XL of 1997), the National Electric Power Regulatory Authority is pleased
to approve the following amendments in the National Electric Power Regulatory
Authority Licensing Procedure for Filing Appeals) Regulations, 2012, notified
vide S.R.O.No.1264(I)/2012 dated 9th October, 2012 with immediate effect:
After
sub-regulation (1) of the Regulation 7, sub-regulation (2) shall be added as
under:-
(2) The
appellant shall also provide information provided in Form-D to these
regulations.
2. Following
Form 'D' to be added in the 'Schedule' of the Regulation:
SCHEDULE
Form-D (to be filled by Appellant)
(i) Date
of Issuance of order against which the appeal is filed.
(ii) Mode
of delivery of the Order to the appellant.
(iii) Date
of receipt of the order by appellant along with evidence
(iv) Whether
this decision given with the consent of the parties?
(v) Whether
the decision against which appeal is filed is interim order?
(vi) Whether
appeal is being filed within 30 days of receipt of the order by the appellant,
if not reason thereof?
(vii) Whether
appeal is being submitted on prescribed format (Form A, B,C & D) of the
Regulations?
(viii) Mode of delivery through which appeal is
being sent by the appellant.
(ix) Whether
appeal is addressed to Registrar NEPRA?
(x) Whether
affidavit duly signed by appellant, verified by Oath Commissioner is attached
with the appeal?
(xi) Whether
appeal is :
Typed-written
and legible
Written
on one side of the paper
Typed
on good quality of paper
Typed
on legal paper
Typed
in double space
Whether
all sheets are stitched together
Whether
every page is consecutively numbered
(xii) Whether
four sets in a paper book are submitted?
(xiii) Whether memorandum of appeal filed concisely
under distinct heads?
(xiv) Whether grounds of such appeal are numbered
consequently?
(xv) Whether certified copy of order against which
appeal is being filed is attached with every copy of the memorandum?
(xvi) Whether written authorization in favour of
signatory of the appeal is attached in case appellant or respondent is
representing by his/her representative?
(xvii) Whether fee of Rs. One thousand (1000) in
form of bank draft in favour of NEPRA is enclosed?
Other
contents of the S.R.O. No.1264(I)/2012 shall remain un-changed.
